scenes.title: Awakening in Xylos
scenes.conflict: She is trapped in an obsidian city
scenes.outcome: She awakens in a cell and immediately starts planning her escape
scenes.consequence: Sets the stage for the action-packed tone of the chapter

scenes.title: Meeting Silas
scenes.outcome: Elara learns of the Void's secrets and Silas' obsession
scenes.consequence: Provides context for Elara's defiance and Silas' influence

scenes.title: City Attack
scenes.outcome: Elara uses her newfound knowledge of the Void to overpower the city's forces
scenes.consequence: Raises the stakes and emphasizes Elara's rebellious nature

scenes.title: Escape to Whisperwood
scenes.outcome: Elara and Silas make their way to the bioluminescent forest of Whisperwood
scenes.consequence: Sets the stage for the next chapter's setting and reveals the extent of Silas' corruption
